name: Mourning Dove
facts: Call pattern: a soft, drawn-out "coo-OO-oo, coo, coo," often mistaken for an owl.
Habitat: open ground, farm fields, wires and backyards. Its wings make a sharp whistle on takeoff.
Migration: partial. Northern birds move south, and pairs can raise several broods in a single year.
